input.rationale: No non-compete or field-of-use covenant binds Sparkling. Section 3 (Restrictions on Use), including the Page 2 continuation at 3(g), is limited to conventional licence-scope restrictions (copying, assignment, reverse engineering, use of the Work, service-bureau use) and does not restrict the businesses Sparkling may operate or competing routing products it may buy or develop. Section 19 is a mutual one-year non-solicitation of employees, not a non-compete, and Section 14 confidentiality contains no residual bar on developing competing software (it expressly carves out independently developed information). Searches for "compet", "exclusiv", "similar software" and "shall not develop" returned no restrictive covenant against us, so the preferred position (no non-compete on Customer) is met and no redline is required.
